hints.en: `math.ceil` rounds up: `math.ceil(1.2)` is 2. Lists count from 0, so `ordered[rank - 1]`.

hints.tr: `p` 0 iken `rank - 1` -1 olur ve son elemanı verirdi; `max(rank, 1)` bunu önler.
hints.en: When `p` is 0, `rank - 1` would be -1 and give the last element; `max(rank, 1)` prevents that.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

```python
import math


def percentile(values, p):
    if not values:
        return None
    ordered = sorted(values)
    rank = math.ceil(p / 100 * len(ordered))
    return ordered[max(rank, 1) - 1]


latencies = [12, 15, 11, 14, 13, 90, 12, 16, 13, 14,
             12, 15, 13, 11, 14, 12, 13, 15, 14, 250]
print("p50:", percentile(latencies, 50))
print("p95:", percentile(latencies, 95))
print("p99:", percentile(latencies, 99))
print("empty:", percentile([], 50))
```
